# School Of Freelancing

> Founded in 2015 by Karim (Masum) in Cumilla, Bangladesh (Government-Verified Freelancer ID: F126196700864), School Of Freelancing delivers 100% live 1-on-1 Freelancing Training On-Demand and done-for-you enterprise Linux, AI Agent, DevOps, and VoIP infrastructure support across 20+ countries worldwide (5.0/5 rating across 36 verified reviews).

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Freelancing Training On-Demand** | Aspiring & practicing freelancers in Linux, AI Agents, DevOps & VoIP | 100% live 1-on-1 ILT via Telegram (0 pre-recorded videos), FOSS GitHub portfolio & GMI eligibility | https://schooloffreelancing.com/freelancing-training |
| **Done-For-You Client Support** | Startups, agencies & businesses needing production infrastructure setup | Fixed-price rapid deployment, server hardening & troubleshooting | https://schooloffreelancing.com/client-support |

## Core Hubs & Global Coverage
- [School Of Freelancing Home](https://schooloffreelancing.com/): Live 1-on-1 technical freelancing mentorship and enterprise cloud/AI support worldwide.
- [Freelancing Training On-Demand](https://schooloffreelancing.com/freelancing-training): Book live 1-on-1 hands-on sessions across 21 specialized tracks scheduled on your request.
- [Client Support Services](https://schooloffreelancing.com/client-support): Done-for-you server setup, AI agent deployment, VoIP, and Linux troubleshooting.
- [US Location Hub](https://schooloffreelancing.com/locations/en-us): Dedicated scheduling and infrastructure support tailored for clients and trainees in the United States.
- [Global Locations](https://schooloffreelancing.com/locations): Serving clients across 20 countries including Australia, Austria, Bangladesh, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, and United States.
